arxiv-1901-07174.title: Clustering of Hotspots in the Cosmic Microwave Background
arxiv-1901-07174.creator: \firstname \lastname Low \firstname En Zuo Joel, \firstname Abel \lastname Yang \fnsep
arxiv-1901-07174.description: Abstract The physics behind the origin and composition of the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) is a well-established topic in the field of Cosmology. Literature on CMB anisotropies reveal consistency with Gaussianity PlanckRes16 , but these were conducted on full multi-frequency temperature maps.

arxiv-2104-02245.title: Multi-Scale Context Aggregation Network with Attention-Guided for Crowd Counting
arxiv-2104-02245.creator: Xin Wang 1,2 , Rongrong Lv 1 , Yang Zhao 2 , Tangwen Yang 1 ✉ {}^{\textrm{{\char 0\relax}}} , Qiuqi Ruan 1,2
arxiv-2104-02245.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Xin Wang 1,2 , Rongrong Lv 1 , Yang Zhao 2 , Tangwen Yang 1 ✉ {}^{\textrm{{\char 0\relax}}} , Qiuqi Ruan 1,2. Crowd counting aims to predict the number of people and generate the density map in the image. There are many challenges, including varying head scales, the diversity of crowd distribution across images and cluttered backgrounds.

arxiv-2106-15179.title: Wrong Colored Vermeer: Color-Symmetric Image Distortion
arxiv-2106-15179.creator: Hendrik Richter
arxiv-2106-15179.description: Abstract Color symmetry implies that the colors of geometrical objects are assigned according to their symmetry properties. It is defined by associating the elements of the symmetry group with a color permutation. I use this concept for generative art and apply symmetry-consistent color distortions to images of paintings by Johannes Vermeer.

Altieri 15, A. Amara 16, N. Auricchio 17, D. Bonino 18, E. Branchini 19,20, M. Brescia 7, J. Brinchmann 21, S. Camera 22,23,18, V.
arxiv-2204-08727.description: Abstract Pair-instability supernovae are theorized supernovae that have not yet been observationally confirmed. They are predicted to exist in low-metallicity environments. Because overall metallicity becomes lower at higher redshifts, deep near-infrared transient surveys probing high-redshift supernovae are suitable to discover pair-instability supernovae.

arxiv-2402-08385.description: Abstract . A survey of some recent advances in parabolic Hitchin systems (parabolic Bouville–Narasimhan–Ramanan correspondence, mirror symmetry for parabolic Hitchin systems), and in exact methods of solving the non-parabolic Hitchin systems. 1. arxiv-2407-18226.creator: Artur M. Ankowski, Omar Benhar, Makoto Sakuda
arxiv-2407-18226.description: Abstract The determination of the nuclear spectral function from the measured cross section of the electron-nucleus scattering process e + A → e ′ + p + ( A − 1 ) e+A\to e^{\prime}+p+(A-1) is discussed, and illustrated for the case of a carbon target.

arxiv-2503-23746.title: Short-video Propagation Influence Rating: A New Real-world Dataset and A New Large Graph Model DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: ; ;
arxiv-2503-23746.creator: Dizhan Xue, Jing Cui, Shengsheng Qian, Chuanrui Hu, Changsheng Xu
arxiv-2503-23746.description: Abstract . Short-video platforms have gained immense popularity, captivating the interest of millions, if not billions, of users globally. Recently, researchers have highlighted the significance of analyzing the propagation of short-videos, which typically involves discovering commercial values, public opinions, user behaviors, etc.

arxiv-2506-15980.title: Advanced Sign Language Video Generation with Compressed and Quantized Multi-Condition Tokenization
arxiv-2506-15980.creator: Cong Wang 1, Zexuan Deng 1, Zhiwei Jiang 1, Fei Shen 2, Yafeng Yin 1, Shiwei Gan 1 Zifeng Cheng 1 Shiping Ge 1 Qing Gu 1
arxiv-2506-15980.description: Abstract Sign Language Video Generation (SLVG) seeks to generate identity-preserving sign language videos from spoken language texts. Existing methods primarily rely on the single coarse condition ( e.g. , skeleton sequences) as the intermediary to bridge the translation model and the video generation model, which limits both the naturalness and expressiveness of the generated videos.

arxiv-2509-07085.title: Resonant axion and dark photon production in magnetic white dwarfs
arxiv-2509-07085.creator: Nirmalya Brahma, Ella Iles, Hugo Schérer, Katelin Schutz
arxiv-2509-07085.description: Abstract Using magnetic white dwarfs as a case study, we show that the emission of sub-MeV bosons from stellar plasmas can be substantially modified in the presence of a magnetic field. In particular, the magnetic field-induced anisotropy and cyclotron resonance both significantly affect the in-medium dispersion relations of the Standard Model photon.

arxiv-2512-22606.title: Gold Price Prediction Using Long Short-Term Memory and Multi-Layer Perceptron with Gray Wolf Optimizer
arxiv-2512-22606.creator: Hesam Taghipour, Alireza Rezaee, Farshid Hajati
arxiv-2512-22606.description: Abstract The global gold market has long attracted financial institutions, banks, governments, funds, and micro-investors. Due to the inherent complexity and interdependence between important economic and political components, accurate forecasting of financial markets remains challenging. Therefore, providing a model that can accurately predict future market behavior is highly valuable.

arxiv-2601-14385.title: Mirror images of lensed star clusters with mismatched spectral energy distributions: A possible signature of top-heavy stellar initial mass functions and extreme stars in high-redshift star clusters 2026 Mirror images of lensed star clusters with mismatched spectral energy distributions: A possible
arxiv-2601-14385.creator: E. Zackrisson, J. M. Diego, J. M. Palencia, Francesco Gabrielli, A. Nabizadeh, Angela Adamoand Guglielmo Costa
arxiv-2601-14385.description: Abstract Strongly lensed star clusters have recently been detected up to redshift z ≈ 10 z\approx 10 in galaxy cluster fields using the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). When pairs of mirror images of such star clusters appear across the lensing critical curve, it is usually assumed that both images will display identical spectral energy distributions (SEDs).

britannica-1911-monzonite.title: Monzonite (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-monzonite.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-monzonite.description: Article 'Monzonite' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. acquired it from their most celebrated occurrence, that of Monzoni in Tirol. The rocks are of granitic appearance, usually rather dark grey in colour and fine to moderately coarse grained. The special characteristic which distinguishes them from granites and ordinary syenites is the presence of plagioclase and orthoclase felspars in nearly equal amounts.

philosophy-4-a-story-of-harvard-universi.title: Philosophy 4: A Story of Harvard University
philosophy-4-a-story-of-harvard-universi.creator: Owen Wister

pmc-10642022.title: Evaluation of a novel biomechanics-informed walking frame, developed through a Knowledge Transfer Partnership between biomechanists and design engineers
pmc-10642022.creator: Sibylle Brunhilde Thies, Susan Bevan, Matthew Wassall, Blessy Kurissinkal Shajan, Lydia Chowalloor, Laurence Kenney, Dave Howard
pmc-10642022.description: BackgroundWalking aids such as walking frames offer support during walking, yet paradoxically, people who self-report using them remain more likely to fall than people who do not. Lifting of walking frames when crossing door thresholds or when turning has shown to reduce stability, and certain design features drive the need to lift (e.g. small, non-swivelling wheels at the front).

pmc-10647344.title: The Role of Continuing Professional Training or Development in Maintaining Current Employment: A Systematic Review
pmc-10647344.creator: Rahman Shiri, Ashraf El-Metwally, Mikael Sallinen, Marjaana Pöyry, Mikko Härmä, Salla Toppinen-Tanner
pmc-10647344.description: The impact of continuing job education and professional development on early exit from the labor market is unclear. This systematic review examined how continuing job education or professional development influences the retention of current employment. We searched the PubMed and Embase databases from their start dates to January 2023.

pmc-10655992.title: Sociodemographic characteristics and longitudinal progression of multimorbidity: A multistate modelling analysis of a large primary care records dataset in England
pmc-10655992.creator: Sida Chen, Tom Marshall, Christopher Jackson, Jennifer Cooper, Francesca Crowe, Krish Nirantharakumar, Catherine L. Saunders, Paul Kirk, Sylvia Richardson, Duncan Edwards, Simon Griffin, Christopher Yau, Jessica K. Barrett
pmc-10655992.description: BackgroundMultimorbidity, characterised by the coexistence of multiple chronic conditions in an individual, is a rising public health concern. While much of the existing research has focused on cross-sectional patterns of multimorbidity, there remains a need to better understand the longitudinal accumulation of diseases. This includes examining the associations between important sociodemographic characteristics and the rate of progression of chronic conditions.

pmc-10690829.title: Improvement of anxiety in ADHD following goal-focused cognitive remediation: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-10690829.creator: Kjersti T. Hanssen, Erlend J. Brevik, Milada C. Småstuen, Jan Stubberud
pmc-10690829.description: IntroductionDespite the high prevalence and detrimental consequences of cognitive and executive dysfunction in ADHD, the evidence base of cognitive remediation in the adult ADHD population is sparse. Executive problems can increase both anxiety and depression in ADHD. Thcus, it is important to develop treatment options for adults with ADHD, aiming to improve goal-directed behavior and mood.

pmc-11650341.title: Diagnostic status and new explorations in upper urinary tract urothelial carcinoma: a literature review
pmc-11650341.creator: Zujuan Shan, Xin Deng, Liansheng Yang, Guifu Zhang
pmc-11650341.description: Background and ObjectiveUpper urinary tract urothelial carcinomas (UTUCs) are characterized by their obscure location, insidious onset, and propensity for early muscle-invasive and lymph node metastasis, resulting in a generally poor prognosis. Clinically, diagnosis primarily relies on urine cytology, computed tomography urography (CTU), and white light ureteroscopy (WL-URS).

pmc-12606345.title: Corrosion fatigue life prediction of multiple austenitic stainless steel grades in high-temperature, high-pressure water environments using a GA-optimized neural network
pmc-12606345.creator: Harsh Kumar Bhardwaj, Mukul Shukla
pmc-12606345.description: Predicting the corrosion fatigue life of austenitic stainless steel (AusSS) in high-temperature, high-pressure water environments remains a complex task due to the intricate interaction of thermal, mechanical, and environmental factors, along with the scarcity of comprehensive experimental data. Traditional empirical fatigue models often fail to capture these multifactorial effects, limiting their predictive accuracy.

pmc-13086621.title: APL‐like subset within NPM1‐mutated AML: A distinct immunophenotype correlating with early vascular complications
pmc-13086621.creator: Francesco Mannelli, Francesca Crupi, Sara Bencini, Michaela Feuring, Gaia Ciolli, Matteo Piccini, Marco Frigeni, Raffaele Palmieri, Chiara Sartor, Barbara Scappini, Giacomo Gianfaldoni, Benedetta Peruzzi, Roberto Caporale, Antonio Scannella, Laura Fasano, Elisa Quinti, Andrea Pasquini, Jessica Carop
pmc-13086621.description: Among NPM1‐mutated acute myeloid leukemia (AML) (NPM1 mut), a distinct subtype has been described with an immunophenotypic profile resembling acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL‐like). In this retrospective multicenter study including 384 NPM1 mut AML patients, we identified 95 (24.7%) cases exhibiting an APL‐like immunophenotype.

pmc-13127986.title: Task-Specific Effects of mGlu2/3 Receptor Agonist LY379268 on MK-801-Induced Behavioral and Neural Dysfunctions in Rats
pmc-13127986.creator: Karolina HRUZA, Daniela CERNOTOVA, Kristyna MALENINSKA, Jan SVOBODA, David LEVCIK, Ales STUCHLIK
pmc-13127986.description: SummaryNMDA receptor hypofunction can lead to behavioral and cognitive disturbances, including hyperlocomotion, and is considered a core pathophysiological mechanism underlying cognitive and negative symptoms in schizophrenia. This study examined whether treatment with the mGlu2/3 receptor agonist LY379268 (1 and 2 mg/kg) could counteract such disruptions induced by the NMDA antagonist MK-801 (0.1 mg/kg).

pmc-13134476.title: Intravenous and Oral Iron Strategies for Iron-Deficiency Anemia in Pregnancy: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials From a Hematology Perspective
pmc-13134476.creator: Hector I Guerra Toro, Arturo P Jaramillo, Genesis Pazmino, Valeria M Caceres
pmc-13134476.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Iron-deficiency anemia is the most common hematologic disorder in pregnancy. Slow iron repletion, poor gastrointestinal tolerance, and late presentation during gestation often limit the effectiveness of oral ferrous salts, which remain the traditional first-line treatment. Intravenous iron offers faster iron delivery, but its role in routine antenatal care remains uncertain, particularly regarding its long-term safety and cost-effectiveness compared to traditional oral iron treatments.

pmc-13172401.title: Selective extraction of lithium from acidic chloride leachates of spent batteries
pmc-13172401.creator: Usman Saleem, Vanja Buvik, Sulalit Bandyopadhyay, Hanna K Knuutila
pmc-13172401.description: Solvent extraction of lithium (Li) from acidic leachates of spent batteries black mass (BM) over nickel (Ni), manganese (Mn), and cobalt (Co) can allow easy integration of Li recycling into conventional hydrometallurgical flowsheets, eliminating the need for thermal pretreatment of BM.

pmc-13433870.title: Analysis of prognostic factors and construction of a nomogram for patients with brain metastases from cancer of unknown primary based on the SEER database
pmc-13433870.creator: Xiaolu Ma, Chuanxia Zhang, Xiaoxi Wan, Heng Lu, Mengyuan Kang, Qianhao Meng, Guangru Xu
pmc-13433870.description: ObjectiveCancer of unknown primary with brain metastases (CUP-BM) represents a distinct and challenging disease entity characterized by an extremely poor prognosis. Currently, there is a lack of systematic research on its prognostic factors. This study aimed to analyze the prognostic factors associated with CUP-BM.MethodsPatients diagnosed with CUP-BM between 2010 and 2022 were identified from the SEER database.
